example:
It seems like people like you just like to bash on hardcore players without listening to reason.

I have accepted my death - I will start over.

What I don't accept is this type of "bend over" content that lacks any sort of perceivable quality to it.

Imagine that Westfall was scattered with lvl 50 goblin rouges all across the zone that are in stealth permanently and just anihilate questing low level Alliance players.

Will it be lore-accurate? Sure. Will it be custom? Yes. Does it make it fun/justified/reasonable just because of these two facts? Hell no.

Justifying badly made custom content with my death is not valid. Justifying my death with this poor quality zone IS valid - but I still don't expect to get revived even if it is valid.

The point of this post is to showcase why this zone is badly implemented and what could be improved - not about my HC death. The zone would be bad even if I were softcore - it just stings a little bit more when you don't simply lose 1 minute walking back, but rather 120 hours of gameplay time (that are preceded by other deaths amounting to hundreds of hours).
pattern: frustration post after being told to 'accept' a Hardcore death
context: Help & Support: HC death acceptance debate

example:
> **Player-0045 wrote: Wed Mar 29, 2023 2:18 pm**
> how do I open an in-game ticket ?

On your action bar you have a little section for Character Info, Spellbook, Talents, Quest Log, etc. You're looking for a tab called "Help Request" with the icon of a red question mark. Click "Issues that a GM can assist with" and choose "Item".

This opens a ticket form where you can describe your problem and ask for assistance. GMs will get back to you once you subtim the ticket.

If you have any UI replacement addons, you might have certain sections of your action bar hidden. In that case you have to navigate the settings of your addon and make them visible again.
